text: INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY1 1

Jade Garrison (23) stands frozen. Her eyes follow Samuel Fisher (25) as he rushes alongside the medical staff, pushing Olivia Garrison (23)-her legs drenched in blood-on a gurney into the operating room. SAMUEL(fiercely)Jade, you’ve taken Olivia’s rightful place in the Garrison family for years. Now that Olivia has reunited with them, you’re trying to kill her? JADEIt wasn’t me! I didn’t do it! Olivia stabbed her own thigh with the knife... SAMUELDo you even believe yourself? Why would Olivia hurt herself so badly? Your jealousy is disgusting! JADE(bitterly)Jealousy? I didn’t even know I was adopted. I don’t care about being the Garrison heiress. I’m your wife—why can’t you believe me? SAMUEL(coldly)Olivia saved my life. You’re just a marriage arrangement. Why would I trust you over her? OLIVIA(Painful to Samuel)Jade, you are a monster! Olivia glances at Jade with a smug expression. Jade, who is framed, looks angry. Jade looks up at Samuel, determined. JADEIn three years of marriage, you’ve ignored all the traps Olivia has set for me.

Even if Olivia died by her own hand today, she deserves it! SAMUELEnough! Get out! Samuel turns to face the surgery doors as Jade, clutching her stomach, weakly leans against the wall. JADE(heartbroken)Samuel… was there ever even a shred of affection for me? Samuel hesitates, fists clenched, but doesn’t turn around. SAMUELNever. Jade leans against the wall, feeling a slight pain in her belly.. JADE (OS)Baby, I’m sorry. Mom will protect you.
INT. FISHER'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - DAY2 2

Jade stumbles into the house, exhausted. Mary(50s), rushes over and splashes water onto Jade's face, startling her. MARYJade, how dare you hurt Olivia! JADE(Forbearingly)I didn’t… Mary slaps Jade across the face. MARY(angrily)If is not for you, Olivia would be my daughter-in-law! You’re an intruder! Jade holds her cheek as tears fall.

JADE(crying loudly)Mom, I didn’t know Olivia existed when I agreed to the arrangement. I truly love Samuel. And… I’m pregnant. Can’t you think about the baby? Mary’s eyes narrow in disbelief. MARY(mocking)You’re pregnant? How could Samuel possibly touch someone as filthy as you? Tell me, whose child is it? Jade looks at Mary’s cruel expression, gives a hopeless smile, and heads upstairs. MARY(cont'd)Jade! You better explain yourself!
INT. FISHER'S HOUSE BEDROOM - DAY3 3

Jade pulls out the divorce agreement from the drawer and the words flash through her mind. SAMUEL (O.S.)Olivia is my savior, and you are just a marriage partner. MARY (O.S.)If you hadn't shown up and wanted to marry Samuel three years ago, my daughter-in-law would have been Olivia. Jade smile bitterly and signs her name. The door was open forcefully and Samuel rush in. SAMUEL(growling)Are you pregnant?
Samuel pulls Jade's arm. She shakes him off. 3

JADE(whispering)Samuel, you’re hurting me… Samuel flies into a rage, holing Jade's face with one hand while guarding Jade's back with the other. SAMUEL(angrily)Answer me! Are you pregnant? Jade’s tears fall as she closes her eyes. JADE(opening her eyes)I’m not pregnant… I lied to your mother… Samuel laughs coldly, and removing his jacket as he approaches her menacingly. SAMUELI knew you were lying. How could I ever believe a woman like you? If you want to get pregnant so badly, fine, I’ll make it happen! Samuel moves closer, but Jade presses her hands against his chest to stop him. JADESamuel, let’s get a divorce. Samuel’s eyes widen in shock. SAMUELJade, do you know what you’re saying? JADE(firmly)I mean it, Samuel. Let’s divorce. Samuel releases her, puts on his jacket, and clenches his fists. SAMUELApologize to Olivia, and I’ll pretend I didn’t hear this. We can go back to how things were. Jade stands and holds Samuel’s hand. 4

JADESamuel, I’m serious. I’ve already signed the divorce papers. SAMUELYou think I’ll let you decide when we marry and divorce? Never. Samuel rips up the divorce papers and storms out. Jade collapses to the floor in tears.

character: INT. GARRISON'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM, DAY5 5
text: Rose(in 50's),Zek (in 50's )and Olivia sit on the sofa. Jade carries her luggage and places the divorce agreement on the tea table. JADEDad, Mom, this is the divorce agreement I signed. Please ask Samuel to sign it later. Zek sighs. ROSEHave you made up your mind? Jade nods and looks down. Zek hands her a black card. JADE (touched)Dad, I don't need it. ZEK Take it. No matter what, you have always been the daughter of our Garrison family. After you left, Olivia will marry Samuel, and you have to live your own life. Olivia smiles softly down her head and Jade takes a deep breath, taking the card. JADEThank you, Dad.
Jade pulls her suitcase towards the door and Samuel grabs Jade's hand. 5

SAMUELWhere are you going? Don't try to escape. I won't divorce you as you wish. Jade looks at Samuel incomprehensible. JADEWhy? Divorce me so you can be with Olivia... SAMUELWhy should my marriage be decides by you? How dare you! Jade smiled wryly and shook off Samuel's hand. JADEI'm tires... Jade turns and left, and Samuel clenches his fists as he looks at her back. SAMUEL (OS)Jade, one day you’ll regret leaving me.
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY7 7

Subtitle: "Five Years Later..." Jade, dressed simply, rushes into the hospital holding five-year-old CHARLIE, her face covered in tears. JADE(anxiously)Doctor! Doctor! Save my child, save my child! Behind Jade, Samuel and Olivia walk holding hands. Both of them are surprised, Samuel lets go of Olivia. Olivia scowls at Jade, but Jade doesn’t notice them. A DOCTOR runs up to Jade and checks on Charlie. DOCTOR(anxious)He is having a febrile seizure! He needs immediate treatment! 6

JADEThank you, doctor! SAMUEL (V.O.)I wonder who dares save this child! Jade whirls around to face the speaker, her eyes locking onto Samuel's in stunned disbelief. A moment later, she collects herself, her expression hardening into a fiery glare aimed directly at him. JADESamuel. Olivia holds Samuel and leans against his arm, as the Doctor stops, bows and steps back. DOCTORMr. Fisher. SAMUEL(walking towards the doctor, indifferently)No hospital is permitted to treat this child without my permission! DOCTORUnderstood, Mr. Fisher. Jade is angry and anxious, tears streaming down her face, and she pulls Samuel's sleeve. JADESamuel, please take out your anger on me. Don't hurt my child… Samuel attempts to shake Jade off his sleeve and walk away, but in the struggle, he accidentally sends her crashing to the ground. Jade desperately clutches at his pant leg. JADE(cont'd)(crying)Samuel, I beg you...please... Samuel purses his lips slightly, and there is a hint of struggle flickers in his eyes. SAMUELFive years ago you left without even looking back. How did you become so worthless now? JADEThat's because Olivia steals… 7

Olivia's expression changes, and she quickly approaches Jade,squats down in a pretentious manner, pulling Jade's arm affectionately. . Olivia But she pinches Jade's arm hard as she speaks. OLIVIA(interrupting)Sis, get up and talk to Samuel. Jade purses her lips in pain and trembles as she stands. Samuel takes Olivia's hand, pulls her up, looks at Jade. SAMUELI think you're getting your comeuppance for injuring Olivia's leg. If you want to save your son, beg me nicely. Olivia covers her mouth to hide her laughter, as Jade clenches her hands and looks at Samuel.
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY8 8

Jade purse her lips and looks at Samuel, who frowns impatiently. SAMUELI will count to three. If you don't kneel down, your son will die today. Three... two... Jade slowly kneels down. JADE(closes her eyes)Mr. Fisher, I beg you, please save my child. Samuel looked at Jade with a mixture of pity and love. He takes a deep breath. SAMUEL Jade, do you remember how high you held your head when you left me five years ago? I wonder which filthy man fathered your son to make you this humble. Jade's face is covered with tears and she looks up at Samuel. 8

JADE (O.S.)Samuel, he is your child... Charlie tugs weakly at Jade's sleeve. CHARLIE(well behaved)Mommy, it’s okay. Mommy, get up. Jade hugs Charlie tightly and looks up at Samuel. JADE (firmly)Can I get a doctor to see my son? Samuel signals to the Doctor with a nod. The Doctor takes Charlie into the emergency room. Samuel smirks and crouches in front of Jade, SAMUEL (smiles evilly)Fine, but I’ll make sure your son is properly supervised. Afterward, you’ll return to the Fisher house and face punishment to pay off your debt. Otherwise... this bastard won't live to see tomorrow. Samuel stands and leaves. Olivia stares venomously at Jade. OLIVIAAfter I took all your money, I can’t believe you didn’t die out there. JADE(coldly)Oh, Samuel’s gone, so now you’ve dropped the act? OLIVIA(gritting her teeth)I don’t care why you’ve returned, but you better get divorced as soon as possible and stay out of my way.
INT. FISHER'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - DAY9 9
Samuel stands in front of Jade, ripping the divorce papers into pieces, scattering them over her. 9

JADEIt's been five years, why are you still refusing to get a divorce? SAMUELYou think you can get away with hiding like a rat? You haven't paid me back for what you owe me! JADE Samuel, tell me what you want me to do, and I’ll do it. Just let me go... SAMUELWhose child is that? Jade hesitates, her lips pressed tightly together. SAMUEL(cont'd)(narrowing his eyes)Afraid to say? (Coldly laughs) No wonder you rushed to divorce me back then. That brat’s been around for a while, hasn’t he?(Grabs her face tightly)Jade, have you been so casual about climbing into other men’s beds? JADE(calmly)Yes, so there's no need for us to continue this sham of a marriage. Samuel’s face darkens, his grip tightening as Jade groans in pain. JADE(cont'd) Samuel, you're hurting me. SAMUEL(coldly)So you do feel pain after all. Samuel stands up and throws a copy of the agreement at her. SAMUEL(cont'd)During our three years of marriage, the Fisher family clothed and fed you. Add in Olivia and your son’s medical expenses, and you owe me five million dollars. 10

JADE(horrified)5 million? Samuel, I am no longer the Garrison heiress, I can't pay back this much money in my lifetime. SAMUEL(sneering)Then live in my house working as a maid and repay it by working as a maid in my house during the day sells wineand entertaining guests at my nightclub at night. I will divorce you and pay your son’s medical bill.You’ll pay it off in a few years. Jade shudders in disbelief. JADEYou want me to entertain guests and serve drinks at your nightclub? Samuel smirks as he turns away. SAMUEL I think you’ll enjoy the job.
INT. FISHER'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - DAY10 10

Jade looks at the contract in her hands, her lips tightly pursed. SAMUEL(indifferently)Didn’t you say you wanted me to let you go? Pay off your debt, and I’ll divorce you. JADE(desperate)I’ll sign! Jade signs her name on the contract, her hand trembling. SAMUELExcellent. Samuel takes the contract and walks away. 11
SAMUEL(cont'd)You’ll start at the nightclub tonight.
INT. NIGHTCLUB HALL - NIGHT11 11

Jade stand in the hall in a sexy short skirt, holding a drink in her hand, shrinking back as TWO MEN come in. They look at Jade. MAN ANew here? Haven't seen you before? MAN B You look pretty good. Come and play with us brothers for a night! Man B says as he tries to touched Jade's thigh; she quickly pulls away. JADEDon't touch me! MAN BWhy are you pretending to be pretentious when you work here? EMMA (20s) rushes over. EMMA Excuse me, everyone. She is new and doesn't know much.(To Jade)There is a guest in the VIP room looking for you. Go there now. Jade holds her cheek and hurries away.
INT. NIGHTCLUB BOX - NIGHT12 12

The door of the box is open. Jade lowers her head and walks in with Emma. EMMAMr. Fisher, I brought you the girl you ordered. Jade's head snaps up and she meets Samuel's cold gaze. ***Payment card point reference 1*** 12
INT. NIGHTCLUB BOX - NIGHT13 13

MR. HILLThis little beauty is new. What a looker! Samuel waves Jade over to him. As she nervously walks over, MR. HILL (40+) nudges her and she stumbles into Samuel's lap, where he hugs her. EMMAMr. Fisher is in a good mood tonight. How about I call a few more for you? SAMUEL(coldly)No need. She'll do just fine. MR. HILL(flatteringly)Mr. Fisher has good taste. This little beauty is fresh and refined. Mr. Hill lustfully tries to touch Jade's arm, but Samuel's face darkens. SAMUEL(Growling)Get out! Emma, Mr. Hill leave the room, Samuel looks at Jade's clothes. SAMUEL (cont'd)You look good in clothes like these. Jade pulls up her collar uncomfortably. Samuel intend to kisses Jade. JADE Don't do this... SAMUEL(raised eyebrows)What’s wrong? Don’t know how to please a man? Or are you pretending to be innocent? 13

As he speaks that, Samuel hugs Jade's waist.Jade looks at Samuel with tears in her eyes. Samuel gets on the sofa next to her and presses himself on top of her. JADE(looking at Samuel desperately)Please stop. Don't do this. SAMUELDon't look at me like that, you are here to sell yourself, not to pretend to be pure! He gets up and sets a bottle of liquor in front of her. SAMUEL(cont'd)Drink it. Jade looks at Samuel, who raises an eyebrow. SAMUEL(cont'd)If you drink it all, you won't have to accompany me tonight. Jade takes a deep breath, then reluctantly picks up the bottle and takes a big gulp.
INT. NIGHTCLUB BOX - NIGHT14 14

Jade finishes the bottle of liquor, her face pale, and her movements sluggish. She sets the empty bottle on the table and holds her mouth, feeling dizzy. SAMUELYou'd rather drink yourself to death than be with me? JADE: Samuel... I... Jade sees Samuel doubled, so she pushes him away and stumbles her way out quickly.
EXT. NIGHTCLUB BACK DOOR - NIGHT15 15
Jade exits the nightclub and leans against the wall, vomiting. 14

On the other side of the wall, Olivia hands stacks of money to a group of gangsters. OLIVIAEnjoy your night. Olivia smiles and walks away. The gangsters quietly approach the back door corner where Jade was vomiting and is siting on the dirty ground. They surround her. JADE Who are you? GANGSTER A Hey, sweetheart. Come play with us. GANGSTER A touches Jade's face and Jade slaps him. Gangster A immediately slaps her back and Jade falls to the ground. GANGSTER A(cont'd)You bitch! Get her! The three Gangsters and try to rip Jade's clothes off. Jade struggles and escapes from She struggles weakly. JADE(terrified)Let me go! Let me go! Jade struggles and escapes from She struggles. She rans forward the nightclub door and falls on the ground badly. JADE (OS)(cont'd)It hurts... It really hurts... Charlie, what are you going to do without your mom? Three Gangsters approaches Jade and surround her. Jade’s vision blurs as the nightclub door suddenly bursts open. Samuel steps out, a long metal rod in hand, his silhouette outlined by the light behind him. He attacks the Gangsters, beating them to the ground before rushing to Jade’s side. JADE (WEAK)(cont'd)Samuel, if I die, will you finally let me go? Jade faints in Samuel’s arms. His grip tightens around her. SAMUELJade, you’re not going anywhere. Don't ever leave me again! ***Payment card point reference 2*** 15

Jade arrives at the mansion with Charlie. He looks up at the grand house, his eyes wide with wonder. CHARLIE(looking at the house)Mommy, I've never seen a house this big! Jade gently pats his head, her eyes dark with sorrow as she gazes at the place she once called home. JADE (OS)Mommy is sorry, this was originally your home.
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY16 16

Samuel and medical staff rush down the hallway, wheeling an unconscious Jade on a stretcher. Samuel clenches her hand tightly as she weakly opens her eyes. JADE(weakly)Samuel, if I die, can you let my son go... SAMUEL(growls)Don’t think you can die and escape from me? If you dare die, I’ll make your son pay for it! Jade is rushed into the emergency room. Samuel grabs the Doctor by his collar. SAMUEL(cont'd)(threatening)If anything happens to her, you'll have me to answer to! The doctor rushes in, and the doors close. Samuel kicks the chair hard and makes a phone call. SAMUEL(cont'd)(to the phone)Hey, check the surveillance camera at the back door of the nightclub for me immediately! Find the thugs and bring them to me.
INT. NIGHTCLUB BOX - DAY17 17

MIKE (20s and tough) opens the box door and comes in. MIKE Mr. Fisher, I brought you the thugs. Samuel, sitting in the middle of the sofa, takes a puff of cigarette and nods slightly. Mike goes out then pushed the Three Gangsters into the room. he then kicks them to their knees, trembling as Samuel exhales a cloud of smoke. Samuel raises an eyebrow. 16

SAMUEL Are you going to confess? GANGSTER AMr. Fisher, we were just tempted by her beauty... Samuel raises his finger, and Gangster B is dragged out into the hall. There is a scream. Gangsters A and C begin to tremble. GANGSTER A(cont'd)Mr. Fisher, we will never touch your woman again... Samuel impatiently takes a puff of his cigarette and looks at Mike. Gangster C is carried out, screaming. GANGSTER C (O.S.)My hand! My hand is gone! Gangster A crawls to Samuel's feet trembling all over. GANGSTER A(crying)Olivia, it was Olivia. She paid us to do it! Samuel pauses, presses out his cigarette, and clenches his jaw. ***Payment card point reference 4***
INT. NIGHTCLUB BOX - DAY18 18

Mike hang up the phone and looks at Samuel. MIKE Mr. Fisher, Mrs. Fisher went to the hospital. Samuel takes a deep breath, stands up, pulls his legs out of Gangster A's hands, and straddles his body. SAMUEL(to Mike)Clean this up. MIKE Yes! 17
GANGSTER A(terrified)Mr. Fisher! Mr. Fisher! Samuel walks away.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY19 19

Jade hugs Charlie tightly and looks at Mary. Mary is so angry she purses her lips and rushes over to slaps Jade. MARY(gritting her teeth)Bitch, you dare to come back! What, is playing pitiful your new trick to seduce Samuel? Charlie pushes Mary away forcefully and Mary looks at Charlie in shock. CHARLIE(staring)Old witch, stay away from my mommy! MARY(sneering)Jade, you have a bastard son and you still have the nerve to come back? Jade looks down and smiles softly. JADEYou want me to leave? Fine. If you have the guts, just ask Samuel to sign our divorce agreement. Or have you been unable to persuade your son for five years? Mary stamps her feet angrily and points at Jade. MARY Jade! How dare you threaten me! As Mary says this, she raises her hand to hit again, but it is held back by someone's hand. Mary and Jade looks over and sees Samuel with a cold expression on his face. CHARLIE(shouting)The old witch is hitting my mom! 18

SAMUEL Mom, it will have a bad influence if the kid keeps yelling like that. Mary pulls her hand away and glares at Samuel. MARYSamuel, I'm telling you this for the last time. Divorce with her today and marry Olivia. Samuel looks at Jade and then at Mary. SAMUEL Mom, I'm telling you one last time. Don't bother Jade again. Jade looks up in surprise.
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY20 20

Samuel and Mary walk out of the ward, and Mary pretends to have a tantrum. MARY (sobbing)Samuel, you obviously hated that bitch before. Why are you lenient on her now? Samuel pats Mary on the shoulder. SAMUELMom, that woman bullied Olivia for three years. I want her to pay back everything and beg me for a divorce. Mary wipes her tears and looks at Samuel. MARYDo you really think so? Samuel nods and Mary breathes a sigh of relief. MARY(cont'd)Well, don't delay it too long. SAMUEL I won't. 19
Mary leaves and Samuel lets out a sigh of relief.

Jade sits half-dressed on the floor, clutching her coat, while Samuel nonchalantly puts his clothes back on. JADE(helplessly)Stella saw everything. You should leave quickly. SAMUEL(chuckles)I've already spent money, so of course I have to enjoy the service before leaving. Jade gives a bitter smile, crouching and trying to stand. JADEAren’t you worried Olivia will find out you came looking for me?

Samuel steps closer and, instead of answering directly, takes the coat from Jade’s hands, helps her put it on, and tidies her hair. Samuel takes the coat from Jade's hand and helps her put it on. SAMUELJade, you still don’t understand the rules here. Guests’ personal affairs are none of your business. Jade bites her lip and looks up at him, her eyes filled with tears. Samuel smirks and gently touches her face. 32
SAMUEL (cont'd)How do you think I was earlier? Should I have done more? JADEYou’re shameless. Jade pushes Samuel away and turns to leave.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY21 21

Samuel come in with his hands in his pockets, and Charlie is no longer in the room. SAMUELWhere's that little devil? JADECharlie was scared, so I asked the nurse to take him to buy a snack. Samuel looks at the slap mark on Jade's face, couldn't help but touch her wound with his fingertips. Jade dodges. SAMUEL(seriously)Does it hurt? You deserve it. Jade purses her lips and looks down. JADEAnyway, thank you for saving me... Before Jade could finish, Samuel Interrupts her. SAMUEL(laughing)What? Are you moved by this? Jade looks up at Samuel and frowns, looking pitiful. JADESamuel, it hurts... Samuel purses his lips slightly. SAMUELJade, if this is your new trick to seduce people, it's a success. Samuel lifts Jade's head and kisses her.
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY22 22
Samuel kisses Jade until she is breathless and then lets go. Jade looks at Samuel with watery eyes. 20

SAMUEL(sneering)Just a kiss, and you’re already this shaken? Trying to seduce me? Jade quickly lowers her head. JADE Samuel, please don't say that. Samuel presses Jade against the head of the bed and studies her face. SAMUEL Saving your life and giving you a kiss doesn’t mean I have any feelings for you. You don’t actually think I’m in love with you, do you? Jade's tears fall. JADENo, I’ve long since understood what our relationship is. SAMUEL(coming closer)Enough with the pitiful act. I saved you because I didn’t want you dying outside my nightclub and ruining its reputation. Otherwise, I wouldn’t have bothered. Jade closes her eyes in humiliation. Samuel frowns, stands up, turns around and prepares to leave. Jade lowers her head weakly and smiles at herself. JADESamuel, don't worry, I won't expect anything of you again. Samuel pauses and drops his eyes. SAMUELSounds great. You'll be discharged from the hospital tomorrow then work as a nanny at home. Don't forgot you own me $5 million. Samuel lifts his legs and leaves, and Jade leans back on the bed and cries.
INT. FISHER'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - DAY24 24

Samuel walks into the living room and looks at Jade, and Charlie behind her. SAMUELI don’t recall the agreement saying you could bring family along. Jade squeezes Charlie's hand. JADE (fawning)Mr. Fisher, Charlie is still young. It's not safe to leave him alone in the basement we rent. He can play by himself in the utility room and won't disturb you. SAMUEL(raised eyebrows)You rent a room in a basement? Jade purses her lips and looks down. SAMUEL (cont'd)(sneering)You are really like a mouse that fears the light. Go make my lunch. JADE Yes, sir. Jade takes Charlie away. Mike greets Jade with a polite bow. 22

MIKE Mrs. Fisher, please take care. SAMUEL(yelling)Mike, who told you to call her that? She's just a nanny. Mike covers his mouth in fear. Jade and Charlie are startles and hurry away. SAMUEL(cont'd)(to Mike in a low voice)By the way, can people live in our basement? Mike looks at Samuel, whose chin rests on his hands, looking as if he's thinking seriously.
INT. FISHER'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - NIGHT42

Jade enters the room and Samuel follows. Samuel snorts coldly. SAMUELWho is he? Is your son also born to that bastard? JADEI've slept with so many men, how can I know whose child he is? Samuel's eyes turn scary. SAMUELYou finally admitted it! JADE(provocatively)Fortunately, Mr. Fisher is magnanimous and still doesn't want to divorce me. Samuel sneers. SAMUELDon't try to provoke me, Jade. If he continues to pester you, as your husband, I'm beat the bastard. Jade panics instantly, unsure where she got the courage to yell at Samuel. JADEDon't bother him!(lowers head and whispers)It's me, I'm the one who likes and pesters him. It's my fault, it has nothing to do with him. Samuel's teeth were chattering, he pulls Jade up and bites her ear. SAMUEL Then show me how you seduced him. 40

Jade purses her lips, tears welling up in her eyes, she slowly takes off her coat, put her arms around Samuel's waist and kisses his neck. Samuel's eyes are fix on Jade, and his Adam's apple rolls up and down. Jade lowers her head and is about to take a step back when Samuel grabs her around the waist and pulls her close. SAMUEL (cont'd)(hushed)Are you done? Jade bites her lower lip and says nothing. Samuel kisses Jade's lips, picks her up and puts her on the sofa, pressing his body against hers, and kisses her softly. Jade close her eyes. JADE (OS)(doubtful)Is his gentleness genuine at this moment?
INT. GARRISON'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - NIGHT43
Olivia smiles calculatingly - and sits down next to Rose, who is reading the newspaper, takes her arm. OLIVIAMom, I need to tell you a secret about Jade's new job. Rose looks at Olivia.
INT. FISHER'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - DAY25 25

Olivia happily runs into the house with a box of snacks, talking as she enters. OLIVIA Samuel! Come and try the cookies I made...(sees Jade)Oh... She stops abruptly upon seeing Jade mopping the floor. Both women’s smiles fade. OLIVIA(cont'd)(patiently)Jade, why are you here, where's Samuel? JADE(coldly)Upstairs. Olivia glances upstairs, put the cookies on the table, walks over to Jade, and snatches the mop from her hand. OLIVIAJade, how can you do such rough work? Olivia kicks over the bucket, spilling dirty water across the floor. 23

OLIVIA(cont'd)(sneering)Oh, you see, you just can't do it well. Jade takes a deep breath, grabs the mop and starts cleaning the water, and Olivia steps on the mop. OLIVIA(cont'd)(gritting her teeth)What on earth do you want by staying at Fisher's house? Jade straightens up and glares at Olivia. JADEYou should ask Samuel why he hasn't divorced me yet. OLIVIA (furious)You! Olivia raises her hand to hit Jade. SAMUEL (O.S.)Olivia! Olivia's fierce expression freezes on her face, but she immediately puts on a smile and smooths her hair. Samuel slowly comes off the bottom steps. Samuel, standing between the two of them, glances at Jade, then deliberately raises a doting smile and pinches Olivia's face gently. SAMUEL(cont'd)Let's not waste time here, let's go out for dinner. OLIVIA(cute)Okay. Samuel puts his hand on Olivia's shoulder and glances at Jade. SAMUEL Why don't you come and serve your future Mrs. Fisher? Olivia sneered triumphantly and Jade nods slightly. 24
INT. FISH'S HOUSE BASEMENT ROOM - DAY26 26

Jade opens the basement room with a lunch box filled with vegetables. Charlie, who was playing with his toy car, jumps up happily. CHARLIEMommy! Jade makes a "hush" gesture, places the lunch box in front of Charlie, opens it, and Charlie takes a few quick sniffs. CHARLIE(cont'd)It smells so good, mommy! JADE(relieved)I'm glad you like it. Olivia suddenly opens the basement room door and appears behind Jade. OLIVIAOh my, what a joyful scene. Jade shields Charlie with her body, her voice steady. JADEOlivia, what do you want? Olivia smiles softly. OLIVIAI've wanted for ask you something for a long time. I took all your money. So how do you give birth to your son? Where did you possibly find a man willing to give you money? JADE Olivia, I don't owe you a response. I have tolerated your repeated attempts at framing me. But if you continue to push your luck... OLIVIA(Interrupting)And what if I do? Olivia closes the door, steps into the basement and kicks the lunch box out of Charlie's hand. 25

OLIVIA(cont'd)(sneering)With your current pathetic state, what can you possibly do to me? JADEDo you know why Samuel hasn't married you yet? Do you really think you haven't shown any flaws all these years? Olivia pulls Jade by her hair and slams her head against the wall. OLIVIA(fiercely)You dare to mention Samuel to me? You slut who seduces men everywhere! You wouldn't mistake Samuel for falling in love with you, would you? I saved his life. Samuel can only be with me! CHARLIE(pulling)Let go of my mommy! You ugly monster who is unloved and jealous of my mommy! Olivia throws Charlie off and he falls to the ground. JADE Charlie! OLIVIA We'll see.
